div.head: VI Atr 36
div.ab: ⁊ gif morðwyrhtan oððe mansworan oððe æbære manslagan to þam geþristian þæt hy on þæs cyninges neaweste gewunian, ær þam þe hy habban bote agunnen for Gode ⁊ for worolde, þonne plihton hy heora are ⁊ eallon heora æhten, butan hit friðbenan syndan.

And gif morðwyrhtan oððe mansworan oððe æbære manslagan to þam geþristian, þæt hy on þæs cyninges neaweste gewunian ær þam þe hy habban bote agunnen for Gode and for worolde, þonne plihton hy heora are and eallon heora æhtan, butan hit friðbenan syndan.

Und wenn Mordstifter oder Meineidige oder offenbare Todtschläger sich soweit erfrechen, dass sie in des Königs Umgebung bleiben, bevor sie in Kirchlichem und Weltlichem Busse begonnen haben, dann sollen sie Verwirkungsgefahr über ihren Grundbesitz und all ihre Fahrhabe bringen, ausser wenn es Asylerbitter sind.

And if murderers or perjurers or open manslayers are so bold as to remain in the king's presence before they have begun to make amends in matters spiritual and secular, then let them put at risk their landed property and all their goods, unless they are suppliants for protection.

And if those who secretly compass death, or perjurers, or proved homicides presume so far as to remain anywhere near the king, before they have undertaken to make amends both towards church and state, they shall be in danger of losing their (landed) property and all their personal possessions, unless they are suppliants for protection.

And if murderers or perjurers or convicted killers are so bold as to remain in the king’s proximity before they have undertaken to do penance before God and the world, then they will be at risk of losing their property and all their possessions, unless they are seeking protection.
